text.title: Django + Celery Background Jobs Failure Modes
text.summary: 7 antipatterns observed in real deployments. Each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Task fires but the row it needs does not exist yet; intermittent 'object not found' errors.
antipattern.root-cause: Bare .delay() called inside @transaction.atomic instead of on_commit.
antipattern.fix: Wrap dispatch in transaction.on_commit(lambda: task.delay(...)) or use task.delay_on_commit if available.

antipattern.symptom: After a refactor that moves `tasks.py`, already-queued jobs deserialise to NotRegistered and dead-letter without an alert.
antipattern.root-cause: @shared_task without a name= argument; the module path was baked into the queued payload.
antipattern.fix: Add an explicit `name=` to every task. Run a one-off script to replay the DLQ jobs under the new name.

antipattern.symptom: Duplicate charges on the same order after a transient broker error; the customer received the same receipt email three times.
antipattern.root-cause: Task lacked an idempotent-key + business_key check on entry; it retried on a broker disconnect with no guard.
antipattern.fix: Add `if already_processed(business_key): return existing_result`; persist `processed_at` against the key in a DB table and reject retries that match a processed key; rerun affected rows once cleaned.

antipattern.symptom: Downstream API goes flaky; thousands of retries land in the same 50ms window.
antipattern.fix: Switch to full jitter; cap max_retries; add a circuit breaker.

antipattern.symptom: Worker pool exhausted; tasks back up for hours because one task hung on an HTTP call.
antipattern.root-cause: Celery defaults assumed; soft_time_limit + time_limit never set.
antipattern.fix: Set soft_time_limit = p95 latency × 2 and time_limit = soft + 30s. Verify with a fault-injected hung-call test.

antipattern.symptom: Low-priority report jobs starved time-sensitive email tasks.
antipattern.root-cause: All tasks went to the default queue behind a single worker pool.
antipattern.fix: Declare explicit queues per task. Start workers with `-Q emails` / `-Q reports` and per-queue concurrency settings.

antipattern.symptom: Webhook task fails 5 times and disappears; nobody notices until customers complain.
antipattern.root-cause: No DLQ; max_retries hit and acked.
antipattern.fix: Add a DLQ + on-call alert; replay queue tool for the on-call to drain.
